facts.fact: The Ministry of Health's annual sector report for FY 2019/20 says it was compiled principally from the ministry's own Health Management Information System, running on District Health Information Software version 2.3, and sources its tables to 'MoH HMIS' and 'MoH DHIS2'.
facts.system: MoH Health Management Information System (HMIS) on DHIS2

facts.fact: The Ministry of Health reports 6,232 facilities reporting through DHIS2 in FY 2019/20 against 6,904 entered from the 2018 Master Facility List: 5 national referral hospitals, 14 regional referral hospitals, 176 general hospitals, 228 HC IVs, 1,592 HC IIIs, 3,659 HC IIs and 561 clinics (1,575 clinics listed), with the reporting rate still very low from lower-level private facilities.
facts.system: MoH Health Management Information System (HMIS) on DHIS2

facts.fact: The Ministry of Health's FY 2019/20 report states that all of the private facilities supported by the USAID Uganda Voucher Plus Activity (146 facilities in 36 northern and eastern districts) were reporting directly into DHIS2 by FY 2019/20, up from 55% at the project's start, the alternative shown being HMIS reporting to the health sub-district or district; it gives no national count of facilities entering their own data.
facts.system: MoH Health Management Information System (HMIS) on DHIS2

facts.fact: The Ministry of Health reports that a revised eHMIS, with new HMIS tools and a new instance of DHIS2, was introduced in January 2020 and the revised tools rolled out across the country; the switch, made while supplies of the new tools were low and orientation incomplete, and the COVID-19 lockdown cut timeliness of the monthly HMIS 105 report from 97% in 2018/19 to 85% in 2019/20, with completeness held above 95%.
facts.system: MoH Health Management Information System (HMIS) on DHIS2

facts.fact: The Ministry of Health's FY 2019/20 report refers to an Electronic Medical Record System 'being rolled out' and names digitisation of the medical record system as its answer to shortages of HMIS tools; the passages give no sites, tiers or counts, and no date beyond the financial year.

systems.system: MoH Health Management Information System (HMIS) on District Health Information Software 2.3
systems.platform: DHIS2 version 2.3; a new instance from January 2020
systems.tiers: 6,232 facilities reporting in FY 2019/20, from national referral hospitals to HC IIs and clinics, public, PNFP and private
Being rolled out in FY 2019/20; sites not stated
400 active user accounts among the ministry and partners; computers distributed to some regional referral and general hospitals for it; used for ordering commodities
Maternal death notification: 853 of 1,192 deaths notified through it in FY 2019/20

systems.system: TB and leprosy case-based surveillance system
systems.tiers: Under development and planning in FY 2019/20

systems.system: VHT/ICCM quarterly report; community health information system
systems.tiers: 104 districts (76%) submitted VHT/ICCM quarterly reports in FY 2019/20; community health information system guidelines in draft; the report does not say whether reporting is digital
Kawolo general hospital; presented to the Health Policy Advisory Committee in FY 2019/20
